title: Online Community and Connection in America
summary_en: Nearly four-in-ten U.S. adults are in an online community. These virtual third spaces can take many forms, like Facebook groups, online video games or fandom forums on Reddit.
title_cn: Online Community and Connection in America

title: Many Americans Are Struggling to Afford Basic Necessities
summary_en: 44% of Americans had trouble paying for a basic necessity in the past year, with lower-income adults hit hardest.
title_cn: Many Americans Are Struggling to Afford Basic Necessities

title: Americans’ Views of Economic Inequality, Its Causes and Who Should Fix It
summary_en: Since 2019, a growing share among those who say there’s too much inequality think the economic system needs to be completely rebuilt to address it.
title_cn: Americans’ Views of Economic Inequality, Its Causes and Who Should Fix It
